dict.string: mnemo transcribes your voice on this Mac while you hold ⌥Space, to type into the focused pane.
mnemo runs git in the repository you opened on your Desktop to find its root, branches and sessions.
mnemo runs git in the repository you opened in Documents to find its root, branches and sessions.
mnemo runs git in the repository you opened in Downloads to find its root, branches and sessions.
mnemo runs git in the repository you opened on this volume to find its root, branches and sessions.
mnemo runs git in the repository you opened on this network volume to find its root, branches and sessions.
